subject: 🏃 Monday — Hip Complex Circuit + Boston Travel Day (Wk 5)
html:
Tomorrow: 20-min Hip Complex Circuit at home, 6 AM, before the SFO→BOS flight at 10:05 AM. This is the Phase 2 kickoff — Strength & Threshold block begins, and it starts with a travel day. The circuit is your standard Monday session: two rounds of 90/90 switches (8–10 each side), adductor rockbacks (8–10), quadruped hip CARs (3 each direction each leg), half-kneeling couch stretch (60 sec each side), plus the PT mobility flush — foam roller T-spine extensions (8–10), standing lunges with hip IR + extension (8–10 each side), and quadruped banded hip IR (5–10 each side).

Focus cue: hip internal rotation. Sink into the IR at the bottom of every hip CAR and hold a beat — bilateral IR limitation is still the #1 PT-flagged driver of your knee issue. This is the session where you chip away at it. Two clean rounds, no rushing to make the flight.

Cold status: You're day 6–7, post-peak, still draining but above-the-neck and trending right. Yesterday's recovery run at HR 134 avg / zero seconds above Z2 was safe and clean. Keep the zinc + Vit C going through the flight and into Boston. The cold should be fully clear by Tuesday's Esplanade tempo — if it's not, we'll adjust.

Travel plan: 5h54m flight. Hydrate aggressively (water + electrolytes), get up and walk the aisle every ~90 min to keep the legs from stiffening, and target lights out by 10 PM ET in Boston. You're jumping 3 hours forward — the eastbound jet lag hits hardest Tue/Wed mornings, and banking sleep tonight and tomorrow night is how you defuse it before Tuesday's 4×1 mi threshold on the Esplanade.

Context: Week 5 of 12, Phase 2 opens. 55 days to the SF Marathon. Phase 1 closed clean — knee 1/5 across every session including a VO2 set and a 10K race while sick, VDOT 54–55 confirmed by Tuesday's 6×1000m. This week is a Boston road trip: hotel-gym DB maintenance Wed, Esplanade tempo Tue/Thu, bodyweight stability Fri pre-flight. The 12 mi long run with gut-training rehearsal lands Sunday Jun 7 after a full Saturday absorption day. Lay out your circuit gear and pack the resistance band tonight — you'll want both for the hotel-room sessions later this week.
